posts.t: Holmstrom lets Hintz walk right by him. Sorokin closes the five-hole and holds on with 14:51 to go in the second. 2-2. #Isles

After Schaefer's mesmerizing goal, Robertson gives DAL a 2-1 lead with 5:28 to go in the first. 

Schenn turnover and Robertson, from behind the goal, just walks to the front and roofs one glove side on Sorokin. #Isles
Sorokin never got square to the shot.

#Isles swarm Oettinger but can't score. #TexasHockey comes down on a 2-on-1 and Stanley plays it perfectly. Sorokin doesn't. Seguin roofs one. 

1-0 with 8:29 to go in the first.
Sorokin gloves a Heiskanen shot and holds on. Shots 4-0 DAL with 14:00 to play in the first. #Isles not having much luck in transition and look shaky defensively.
DAL giving #Isles fits early on in NYI zone. Twice now, NYI have left DAL players wide open. Sorokin sharp early.
Sorokin bails out #Isles, stones Roope Hintz at the top of the crease.
Ilya Sorokin leads out #Isles. Jake Oettinger leads out #TexasHockey. Warmups are underway here at American Airlines Center.
Sorokin starts tonight for #Isles, per DeBoer.
